title: bug: C_SignInit and C_VerifyInit missing CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE guard
description: wp11_pkcs11.c: C_EncryptInit (line ~5111), C_DecryptInit (~5737), and C_DigestInit (~6288) all check 'if (s->OPERATION_active) return CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE' before activating. C_SignInit (~6562) and C_VerifyInit (~6828) are missing this check. Calling C_SignInit while any other operation is active clobbers shared session state without returning an error, leaving the session in a corrupt state. PKCS#11 spec section 11.6 requires CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE if another operation of the same type is already active. Fix: add the same guard to both functions, checking all active flags (sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt, digest) before activating the new operation.
